name: BoundingBox Warp Mirror Host Validation Probe
description: Task-local reconnaissance probe for the BoundingBox overlay whole-object Warp mirror on an exact Cubism host: applies all four directions through the public warpMirror() service, verifies direction labels against results, descendant canvas preservation, atomic Undo/Redo, NO_CHANGE, and fail-closed rejection.

permissions.reason: Reads Warp grids, drawable evaluation snapshots, and model identity to record the probe baseline and verify mirror results.
Applies bounded whole-object Warp mirrors on the task-scoped fixture copy and exercises Undo/Redo on them.
